# Brain-gated burn-in declares its hosted gaps and runs on ten shards

## Context

A leaf of epic #19655, between the `dev`-push burn-in (#19656, merged as #19667) and the pull-request trigger (#19657). #19657 starts only once the burn-in's receipts show every shard within the five-minute ceiling and a green streak with every red dispositioned. Four hosted samples (two branch runs, two `dev` pushes) show neither.

The mechanism was agreed on #19657: [the proposal](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657#issuecomment-6128508705), [Ada's steward confirmation](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657#issuecomment-6128617066), [Euclid's refinements](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657#issuecomment-6128924667) and [the folded result](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657#issuecomment-6128974710). This leaf implements it. #19657's own ACs describe the trigger, and a pull request resolves exactly one ticket.

## The Problem

Reds across the four samples:
- `DemoBDockTransactionsNL`, `TransactionArchiveReplay`: 4/4, `archive-store-unavailable`. CI has no `NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN`, the credential the Memory Core client requires.
- `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL`: 4/4. After horizontal wheel scrolling, the first sort click leaves no grid at all.
- `WorkstationPopOutSparklinesNL:74`: 4/4, the popup closes mid-capture.
- `WorkstationFilmTourNL:223` and `:302`: 3/4 each, the tour stops at journey hop 3 ("no fresh vessel was born") and waits out its 200 s receipt.

A fifth hosted run passed `FilmTour:223` and `Sparklines:74` and failed `FilmTour:302`, so all three are intermittent.

The reds also cost most of the overrun: no shard count fits with them in, and ten shards leave headroom with them out (the replay of Playwright's split is in the proposal).

**`DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL` is diagnosed.** Hosted probes on an unmerged branch:
- Every loss is a history **back** navigation to `about:blank` (`navType: back_forward`), not a grid or registry defect.
- Linux Chrome 154 reads CDP's precise wheel deltas as a touchpad swipe. A horizontal overscroll then commits the back navigation at the next click.
- On one runner, `--disable-features=…,TouchpadOverscrollHistoryNavigation` stopped it (0 of 2, against 2 of 2 in the control). `--overscroll-history-navigation=0`, `overscroll-behavior-x: none` on html and body, and the grid container's own `overscroll-behavior: none` did not.

**The e2e launch args also discard Playwright's own disabled features.** Playwright launches Chrome with its own `--disable-features` list and appends user args after it. Chrome keeps only the last copy. Since `#9394` added `--disable-features=IsolateOrigins,site-per-process`, every e2e run has re-enabled Playwright's list: `PaintHolding`, `ThirdPartyStoragePartitioning`, `AvoidUnnecessaryBeforeUnloadCheckSync` and the rest. Measured locally on Chrome 155, with storage partitioning as the observable:

| Launch args | Partitioning |
|---|---|
| Defaults only | off |
| Defaults plus our list | on |
| Defaults plus any unrelated list | on |
| Our list plus `ThirdPartyStoragePartitioning` | off |

The effect on the hosted reds is unmeasured.

## The Architectural Reality

- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` is the tier's single selection and receipt source (`--brain-paths`, `--brain-receipt`).
- `testIgnore` deselects, so no reporter names what it removes. Playwright 1.63's `--test-list-invert <file>` deselects exact `file › describe › title` paths, relative to `testDir`, before sharding.
- `filterForShard` count-balances contiguous file groups, and `fullyParallel: false` keeps each file atomic.
- `test/playwright/e2e/utils/gpuIntent.mjs` `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` is the one launch-argument list, already carrying `--disable-features=IsolateOrigins,site-per-process`.

## The Fix

1. `BRAIN_CAPABILITIES`: the archive pair, keyed on `NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN`. It applies only while the variable is unset, so a provisioned archive brings both files back with no edit. The residual is tracked on #17844.
2. `BRAIN_QUARANTINES`: `FilmTour:223`, `FilmTour:302` and `Sparklines:74`, each with its title path, reason, accountable seat, exit and `since`. Deselected through `--test-list-invert`; no spec is edited.
3. The unit tier refuses stale declarations on every pull request, so a rename fails in the change that made it:
   - `assertBrainDeclarations` refuses a declaration whose file is not a Brain-gated spec;
   - `assertQuarantinesResolve` requires each quarantine to select exactly one registered test, through Playwright's own `--list` with the entry as the test list. A new enclosing `describe` keeps every string in the source, so only Playwright's matcher catches it.
4. The receipt prints the selection's denominators, every declaration and each quarantine's age, and flags one older than seven days as stale.
5. `TouchpadOverscrollHistoryNavigation` joins `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS`' disabled features, which fixes `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL` instead of quarantining it.
6. Ten shards.
7. `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS`' one `--disable-features` repeats Playwright's list (`PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES`, copied verbatim). The unit tier fails when the installed Playwright's list stops matching the copy.

| `e2eCiSelection.mjs --brain-paths` | #19657 agreed mechanism | Gated paths minus those whose capability is unset; refuses stale declarations | Every capability set → the whole tier | `WhiteboxE2E.md` | Unit arms |
| `e2eCiSelection.mjs --brain-test-list` | Same | The quarantine as a Playwright test list | An empty list deselects nothing | `WhiteboxE2E.md` | `--list` with and without it |
| The shard receipt | #19656 receipt; Ada's refinement 1 | Denominators, every declaration, quarantine age, stale past seven days | No report → "unknown", never zero | `WhiteboxE2E.md` | Unit arms |
| `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` | This diagnosis | No touchpad overscroll history navigation in any e2e launch, and Playwright's own disabled features kept | macOS never triggered the navigation; the flag is inert there. A Playwright upgrade that changes its list fails the unit tier until the copy follows | `gpuIntent.mjs` JSDoc | Hosted probes; the local partitioning probe; `glState.spec.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `--brain-paths` drops `DemoBDockTransactionsNL` and `TransactionArchiveReplay` only while `NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN` is unset. The receipt names them, the reason, the exit and #17844.
- [ ] Each quarantine deselects exactly its test and names its accountable seat, exit and `since`. A receipt flags one older than seven days.
- [ ] The unit tier fails a declaration whose file is not Brain-gated, and a quarantine that does not select exactly one registered test.
- [ ] `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL` passes hosted with the launch flag, and no quarantine covers it.
- [ ] Every launch profile carries exactly one `--disable-features`, and it includes Playwright's own list. The unit tier fails when that list changes.
- [ ] Ten shards. Post-merge: the first `dev`-push receipts (each shard's time against the ceiling) are posted on #19655.
- [ ] `WhiteboxE2E.md` describes both declaration kinds.

## Out of Scope

- The pull-request trigger (#19657).
- Diagnosing the three quarantined tests. Their exits own that, with Grace accountable.
- The intermittent reds, which stay in the run and keep being counted.
- Whether the grid should contain a real touchpad's horizontal overscroll. That is captured as a defect-note, not filed.

## Avoided Traps

- **`--grep-invert`:** a regex over every test's full title can deselect a same-named test in another file. A test list matches one exact path.
- **`test.skip` / `test.fixme` in the specs:** edits authors' files, and a skip reads as coverage.
- **A quarantine without an exit:** becomes the permanent exclusion it was meant to avoid.
- **`overscroll-behavior` on the page:** measured not to stop the navigation.
